source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend the separating horizontal gap as a color-3 line.
    candidates = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]):
            above = {v for v in grid[r - 1] if v != 0}
            below = {v for v in grid[r + 1] if v != 0}
            if above and above == below and len(above) == 1:
                candidates.append(r)
    if candidates:
        for c in range(w):
            out[candidates[0]][c] = 3
    return out
'''
